title: Scrum and versions
summary: Scrum support on top of boards: a backlog, sprint planning, starting and closing sprints (unfinished tickets move to the next sprint or back to the backlog), the active sprint board, estimation in points or hours per board, burndown based on remaining work, velocity over the last N sprints, project versions and releases with generated release notes, and epic progress. This package is important: it can slip just after the MVP without blocking the production release.

stories.title: Plan sprints from the backlog
stories.i_want: a backlog where I rank tickets and plan them into sprints
stories.so_that: the team commits to a realistic sprint scope
acceptance: Given a Scrum board fed by a filter, When I open the backlog, Then I see future sprints and the ranked backlog of tickets not in a sprint
Given I drag a ticket from the backlog into Sprint 25, When I drop it, Then it is added to the sprint and the sprint total estimate updates
Given I reorder tickets in the backlog, When I reload, Then the ranking is kept
Given I lack the 'manage sprints' permission, When I open the backlog, Then I can view it but not create, start or reorder sprints
Given I use only the keyboard, When a ticket is focused, Then I can move it to a sprint or change its rank through accessible actions

tech.title: Create sprint and sprint_issue tables with ranking
tech.description: Add `sprint` (tenant_id, board, name, goal, dates, state future/active/closed) and `sprint_issue` (sprint, issue, added and removed timestamps, to keep history for velocity), plus a backlog rank on issues per board (lexicographic rank to avoid renumbering). RLS on all tables.
done_when: Unit tests for rank generation between two neighbours
Integration tests for RLS isolation and sprint membership history

tech.title: Expose backlog, sprint and ranking endpoints
tech.description: Add endpoints to get the backlog of a Scrum board, create and edit future sprints, add or remove tickets, and rerank. Check the 'manage sprints' permission; emit outbox events for real-time updates.
done_when: Integration tests cover permission, ranking, sprint scope changes and cross-tenant isolation
OpenAPI and Angular client regenerated

tech.title: Build the backlog and sprint planning screen
tech.description: Build the backlog screen following the mockup with CDK drag and drop between backlog and sprints, sprint headers with totals in the board's estimation unit, create sprint dialog, and keyboard move actions.
done_when: Unit tests for drop handling and totals
axe check passes

stories.title: Run and close a sprint
stories.i_want: to start a sprint, follow it on the sprint board, and close it
stories.so_that: unfinished work is handled explicitly and sprint history stays reliable
acceptance: Given a future sprint with dates and tickets, When I start it, Then it becomes active and the sprint board shows its tickets by column
Given another sprint is already active on this board, When I try to start a second one, Then it is refused with an explicit message
Given an active sprint with 3 tickets not in a Done-category status, When I close it, Then I choose to move them to the next sprint or to the backlog
Given a closed sprint, When I view it later, Then its committed and completed scope is preserved

tech.title: Implement sprint lifecycle rules in domain
tech.description: In `crates/domain`, implement start (one active sprint per board, dates required) and close (identify unfinished tickets by status category, move them to the target sprint or backlog, snapshot committed and completed scope).
done_when: Unit tests for start conflicts, close with each target and scope snapshots

tech.title: Expose start and close sprint endpoints
tech.description: Add start and close endpoints applying the domain rules transactionally, writing sprint history and outbox events. The board data endpoint shows only the active sprint's tickets for Scrum boards.
done_when: Integration tests cover start, double active refused, close moving tickets, permission and cross-tenant isolation
OpenAPI and Angular client regenerated

tech.title: Build sprint board and close sprint dialog
tech.description: Reuse the Kanban board component for the active sprint board with a sprint header (goal, dates, days left), and build the start and close `MatDialog`s with the choice for unfinished tickets.
done_when: Unit tests for the dialogs and header
axe check passes

tech.title: Add Playwright test for a sprint cycle
tech.description: Scenario: plan tickets into a sprint, start it, move a card to Done, close the sprint moving the rest to the next sprint, check backlog and next sprint contents.
done_when: Scenario runs green in CI through `just`

stories.title: Estimate in points or hours per board
stories.i_want: to choose whether a board estimates in story points or hours
stories.so_that: each team uses its own estimation practice while workload stays in hours
acceptance: Given a board set to points, When I view backlog and sprint totals, Then they sum the story points field
Given a board set to hours, When I view totals, Then they sum the original estimate in hours
Given a ticket's assignments, When the board uses points, Then the workload computation is unaffected and stays in hours
Given a ticket without estimate, When totals are computed, Then it is counted as unestimated and flagged

tech.title: Add estimation unit to boards and totals computation
tech.description: Use the board's estimation unit (points or hours) to compute backlog, sprint and column totals, with an unestimated count. The rule lives in `crates/domain`; endpoints return totals with the unit.
done_when: Unit tests for totals in both units and unestimated tickets
Integration tests for board totals endpoints

tech.title: Show estimation unit in board settings and totals
tech.description: Add the estimation unit `mat-button-toggle-group` to board settings and display totals and estimate badges with the right unit, localized.
done_when: Unit tests for settings and badge formatting
axe check passes

stories.title: Follow the sprint burndown
stories.i_want: a burndown chart of the active sprint in points or hours
stories.so_that: we see early whether the sprint goal is at risk
acceptance: Given an active sprint on a points board, When I open the burndown, Then I see remaining points per day against the ideal line
Given an hours board, When I open the burndown, Then it is based on the remaining work entered on tickets
Given a ticket is added to the sprint mid-way, When the burndown is drawn, Then the scope increase is visible on that day
Given the chart, When I use a screen reader, Then an equivalent data table is available

tech.title: Compute burndown series from history
tech.description: In `crates/domain`, compute daily remaining values for a sprint from sprint membership history, audit log status changes (Done category) and remaining work estimates, using working days of the tenant calendar for the ideal line.
done_when: Unit tests for points and hours, scope changes, reopened tickets and non-working days

tech.title: Expose the burndown endpoint
tech.description: Add `GET /api/v1/sprints/{id}/burndown` returning the daily series and ideal line.
done_when: Integration tests on seeded history, permission and cross-tenant isolation
OpenAPI and Angular client regenerated

tech.title: Build the burndown chart with table view
tech.description: Build a reusable burndown chart component in `projects/ui` (SVG, colors from tokens only) with an equivalent accessible table, used on the agile reports screen and reusable by the dashboard gadget (L14).
done_when: Unit tests for scaling and table rendering
axe check passes

stories.title: Measure velocity over the last sprints
stories.i_want: a velocity chart comparing committed and completed work over the last N sprints
stories.so_that: I can plan future sprints on actual capacity
acceptance: Given 6 closed sprints, When I open velocity with N = 6, Then I see committed and completed values per sprint and the average
Given I change N to 3, When the chart refreshes, Then only the last 3 closed sprints are shown
Given the chart, When I use a screen reader, Then an equivalent data table is available

tech.title: Compute and expose velocity
tech.description: Compute committed and completed values from closed sprint snapshots in `crates/domain` and expose `GET /api/v1/boards/{id}/velocity?last=N`.
done_when: Unit tests for velocity and average computation
Integration tests for the endpoint, permission and cross-tenant isolation

tech.title: Build the velocity chart with table view
tech.description: Build an SVG bar chart (committed vs completed, token colors) with N selector and accessible table on the agile reports screen.
done_when: Unit tests for the chart and selector
axe check passes

stories.title: Manage versions and generate release notes
stories.i_want: to manage project versions with a release date and status, and generate release notes
stories.so_that: I can plan releases and communicate what each one contains
acceptance: Given project PLAT, When I create version 2.1 with a release date, Then it can be set as fixVersion on tickets and used in `fixVersion = "2.1"`
Given version 2.1 has open tickets, When I view it, Then I see progress by status category
Given I release version 2.1, When open tickets remain, Then I must move them to another version or leave them unreleased
Given a released version, When I generate release notes, Then I get a list of its tickets grouped by type, in the chosen language

tech.title: Create version table and fixVersion field
tech.description: Add `version` (tenant_id, project, name, description, release date, status unreleased/released/archived) with RLS and uniqueness per project, plus the fixVersion system field on issues and its support in the query compiler.
done_when: Integration tests for RLS, uniqueness and `fixVersion` queries

tech.title: Expose version endpoints and release notes generation
tech.description: Add version CRUD, release action (with move of open tickets) and a release notes endpoint returning tickets grouped by type as structured data and Markdown, using the requested language.
done_when: Unit tests for release notes grouping
Integration tests for release with open tickets, permission and cross-tenant isolation
OpenAPI and Angular client regenerated

tech.title: Build versions list and version detail
tech.description: Build the versions table with progress bars (`mat-progress-bar`), create and release dialogs, and a release notes view with copy action.
done_when: Unit tests for the list, dialogs and release notes view
axe check passes

stories.title: Follow epic progress
stories.i_want: each epic to show a progress bar of its child tickets
stories.so_that: I see at a glance how far each epic is
acceptance: Given an epic with 10 child tickets of which 4 are in a Done-category status, When I view it, Then its progress bar shows 40% with To do / In progress / Done segments
Given child tickets in projects I cannot view, When I view the epic, Then progress is computed only from tickets I may see
Given the backlog, When I filter by epic, Then I see only that epic's tickets

tech.title: Compute epic progress by status category
tech.description: Compute counts and estimate sums of an epic's descendants by status category (rule in `crates/domain`) and expose them in the ticket `expand` and on backlog epic lists.
done_when: Unit tests for progress computation
Integration tests for permission filtering and cross-tenant isolation

tech.title: Show epic progress bars and epic filter
tech.description: Add a segmented progress component in `projects/ui` using `--app-status-*` tokens, shown on epic tickets and in the backlog epic panel with an epic filter.
done_when: Unit tests for the progress component and filter
axe check passes
